## Implements

- [A tool definition that declares a customer id, company id or account number in…](https://github.com/re-cinq/otto/blob/46245fd4201a00105b31dee36bd17fa775cf9e64/specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#L96)
- [**FR-031**: Every tool MUST be registered through `apps/api/src/tools/registerT…](https://github.com/re-cinq/otto/blob/46245fd4201a00105b31dee36bd17fa775cf9e64/specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#L133)
- [**FR-034**: Tool definitions registered in `apps/api` MUST NOT declare a custom…](https://github.com/re-cinq/otto/blob/46245fd4201a00105b31dee36bd17fa775cf9e64/specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#L136)

## Context

Prevents tools from bypassing the customer scope resolver by strictly validating their input schemas at registration.

## What to change

Add schema validation in registerTools to refuse any tool whose inputSchema declares customer ID, company ID, or account number fields.

Target file: `apps/api/src/tools/registerTools.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A tool declaring a customer id in its input schema is refused.
- [ ] Every tool is registered through registerTools.

[3] "issue-560" section 3:
## How to test

Write customerBoundary.test.ts to verify that tools with invalid schemas are rejected before registration.

- [specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#functional-requirements](https://github.com/re-cinq/otto/blob/HEAD/specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md#functional-requirements)
